title: ReCAST: Restoration-aware Cascaded Stage-wise Training for Obfuscated SMS Risk Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.04878v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fraudulent messages sent via Short Message Service (SMS) are increasingly obfuscated to evade cost-conscious classifiers in production systems. In Chinese SMS, attackers can exploit a wide range of carefully crafted obfuscation strategies to hide risk-bearing phrases while preserving human readability, making direct classification brittle under real-world latency and throughput constraints. We propose ReCAST, a Restoration-aware Cascaded Stage-wise Training framework for robust obfuscated Chinese SMS classification. ReCAST distills a large teacher model's de-obfuscation ability into a smaller deployable student model by supervising obfuscated span detection, obfuscation type prediction, and text restoration, and then uses the restoration-aware student for downstream risk classification. translated_title: ReCAST：面向混淆短信风险分类的还原感知级联分阶段训练框架
translated_abstract: 通过短信服务（SMS）发送的欺诈短信越来越多地采用混淆手段，以规避生产系统中对成本敏感的分类器。在中文短信中，攻击者可以利用各种精心设计的混淆策略来隐藏带有风险的词句，同时保持人类可读性，这使得在真实世界的延迟和吞吐量约束下，直接分类方法变得非常脆弱。我们提出了ReCAST，一个面向鲁棒混淆中文短信分类的还原感知级联分阶段训练框架。ReCAST通过监督混淆片段检测、混淆类型预测和文本还原三项任务，将大型教师模型的去混淆能力蒸馏到一个更小、可部署的学生模型中，随后使用该具备还原能力的学生模型进行下游风险分类。在内部构建的真实中文短信基准数据集上的实验表明，ReCAST相比直接分类方法显著提升了分类性能。
tldr: ReCAST通过还原感知的级联分阶段训练，将大模型的去混淆能力蒸馏到轻量级学生模型中，从而实现对混淆中文短信的鲁棒且高效的风险分类。
en_tdlr: ReCAST enables robust and efficient risk classification of obfuscated Chinese SMS by distilling a large teacher model's de-obfuscation capability into a lightweight student model through restoration-aware cascaded stage-wise training.
